reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it actively instructs viewers to move euros into a mandatory account and purchase OneCoin tokens as a way to start mining them. The presentation promotes participation in a token-and-mining scheme through a concrete purchase flow, including entering an order and transaction password, rather than warning about or analyzing the offer.

citations.quote: In this video you can see how to buy tokens (or onecoins) from your mandatory account. To start mining your onecoins you can
we will see how to send our Euros from trading account to the exchange to buy tokens
Now I want to buy tokens and I will show you how to do this.
we press bid to buy tokens

opening.argument: The narration describes a procedure, not a promised result: it explains moving euros from a trading account to an exchange, placing an order, and where the purchased tokens should appear. It gives a token price and purchase amount, but makes no statement here that mining income, profit, or any return is guaranteed. The account display and order form show the mechanics of a transaction; they do not, by themselves, establish what a viewer would earn or that the speaker is soliciting a deposit. This is limited evidence about an operation, not evidence of a guaranteed outcome.

citations.quote: we will see how to send our Euros from trading account to the exchange to buy tokens
We want to buy tokens by 0.228 euros.
the Bought amount of tokens will be added to the amount of the tokens which you already have bought

rebuttal.rebuttal: The description's reference to starting mining explains a possible purpose for buying tokens, but it does not state that mining will produce income or guarantee a return. Likewise, a completed order flow demonstrates how to buy, not that the purchase is risk-free or profitable. The cited interface does not establish what happens to tokens after the order or validate any mining outcome.

citations.quote: To start mining your onecoins you can
we press bid to buy tokens

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The video is not merely a neutral account of an interface: its description explicitly connects buying tokens from a mandatory account with starting mining. The speaker walks through buying them and reassures viewers that the amount will be added to their existing tokens. No risk warning or uncertainty qualifies that participation guidance. A guarantee of profit is not required for the content to promote a paid mining scheme.

Money is still there but don't worry, it will get to this section and the Bought amount of tokens will be added to the amount of the tokens which you already have bought

opening.argument: This is most naturally read as an operational tutorial: the speaker says she will show how to move euros, enter a trading account, place a token order, and return to the dashboard to check the account. The narration follows those steps in sequence, and the sampled interface shows the trading account and order form. That supports a demonstration of using an account feature. The footage and narration do not establish that viewers are promised earnings, nor do they explain what mining yields; a tutorial about purchasing tokens is not, on this evidence alone, proof of a deceptive claim.

citations.quote: Now I want to buy tokens and I will show you how to do this.
So we enter trading account section.
Now come back to our Dashboard.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The purchase steps and the description's mining reference do not erase the tutorial format. The speaker explains a specific account operation and reports that the order was accepted; the cited material does not show a claim about mining returns or an appeal to viewers to invest. Calling the subject matter a scheme does not establish that this instructional segment makes a deceptive representation.

citations.quote: we can see our order was accepted
In this video you can see how to buy tokens (or onecoins) from your mandatory account.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The procedure is itself the participation pathway: the description frames the purchase as being from a mandatory account and says it is to start mining, while the speaker demonstrates the buy flow. The tutorial framing does not make that promotion neutral. Its reassurance that purchased tokens will be added to those already bought supports continued participation, even though the speaker does not state a numeric return.

citations.quote: from your mandatory account. To start mining your onecoins you can
we press bid to buy tokens
the Bought amount of tokens will be added to the amount of the tokens which you already have bought

opening.argument: The observable transaction is a purchase of tokens at a stated price through an account interface. The narration describes an order being accepted and where the purchased amount will be reflected; the sampled frames show a trading-account page and a buy-order form. Those facts support an ordinary-commerce reading of a product purchase. The record does not show a promised return, a request to recruit others, or a claim that a viewer must provide credentials to the speaker. A token purchase associated with mining may warrant scrutiny, but these materials do not establish those additional mechanisms or prove that the described transaction deceives buyers.

citations.quote: We want to buy tokens by 0.228 euros.
we can see our order was accepted

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's strongest point is the connection between purchase and mining, but that connection alone does not establish a guaranteed return or a recruitment-based mechanism. The footage shows an order form and the narration describes the purchased token amount; neither establishes the tokens' later value or any income. A mandatory account is mentioned, but that fact alone does not establish that the speaker is collecting viewers' funds or credentials.

citations.quote: from your mandatory account. To start mining your onecoins you can
we can see our order was accepted

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is more than an isolated retail purchase: the description ties buying tokens through a mandatory account to starting mining, and the speaker expressly guides the viewer through the purchase. The account display includes bonus and pay-in fields, while the narration says tokens will be added to those already bought. The absence of a spoken profit guarantee does not negate promotion of paid mining participation.
